items.title: Nvidia, Broadcom, and Micron stocks decline as Anthropic goes public

items.title: AMD stock drops after Hunterbrook Media raises export control concerns

items.title: Blacklisted Chinese server maker kept getting AMD firmware updates: Hunterbrook
items.summary: Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley discuss reporting by Hunterbrook alleging AMD (AMD) kept supplying firmware updates to a U.S.-blacklisted Chinese server maker, raising export-control questions and causing its stock to sink.
